component.name: Token Converter
component.summary: Recursively batch-convert media files in project folders

description.p: Token Converter converts media files inside your project folders in bulk, for example all PNG images to WebP. Each project has its own conversion rules, quality settings and renaming options, seeded from global defaults.

ul.li: Per-project rules such as “png → webp”, lossless or lossy quality
Safe writes: originals are only touched after the result was verified
Replace, trash, back up or keep the originals
Dry-run preview, include/exclude patterns and filename templates
Parallel conversion with pause, resume and cancel
